verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਅਥਰਬਨੁ ਮਥਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਸੇਖਿਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: bedh atharaban mathan kar gurmukh baasekhik gun gaavai|

en.bdb: By churning of the Athatvaveda, the guru-oriented (Kanad) in his Vaisesik recited about gunas, the qualities (of the matter).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਸਮੇ ਬਿਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: jehaa beejai so lunai same binaa fal hath na aavai|

en.bdb: He produced the theory of sowing and reaping(giving and taking) and told that at appropriate time only, one would attain the fruit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੰਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko ma(n)nai hukam so sahaj samaavai|

en.bdb: Everything operates in His divine will, hukam(to which he calls apurva) and whosoever accepts the divine-will stablizes his self in equanimity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੋ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨਹਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: aapo kachhoo na hoviee buraa bhalaa neh ma(n)n vasaavai|

en.bdb: The jiva must understand that nothing happens of its own (and our ownselves are responsible for our good or bad actions) and hence nobody as good or bad should be lodged in mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਲਹੈ ਰਿਖਿ ਕਣਾਦਿਕ ਭਾਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: jaisaa kar taisaa lahai rikh kanaadhik bhaakh sunaavai|

en.bdb: Rishi Kanad has said that as you sow, so shall you reap.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਕਾ ਅਨਿਆਇ ਸੁਣਿ ਇਕ ਫੇੜੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤ ਮਰਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: satijug kaa aniaai sun ik feRe sabh jagat maraavai|

en.bdb: Listen to the injustice of the satyug that only because of a single evil-doer the whole world would suffer.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੇ ਨਗਰੀ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਵੰਸੁ ਕੁਵੰਸ ਕੁਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: trete nagaree peeReeaai dhuaapar va(n)s kuva(n)s kuhaavai|

en.bdb: In the treta, the whole city  suffered because of one evil-doer and in dvapar this suffering was limited to the one family and the family underwent the igominy.
But in the kaliyug only he suffers who commits evil deed.
